P05.1: probabilistic entity resolution — Splink tiers 4-5 to review, the quality gates

The probabilistic top of the resolution cascade, as pure library code + versioned
data (mirroring the P03.2 deterministic cascade; connectors/ER are not DB-wired yet —
the review-queue persistence and curation UI are P05.2):

- Splink 4 on DuckDB as a fully-specified, deterministic matcher (per-level m/u in
  versioned data), so the match weight and its per-comparison Bayes-factor
  decomposition are reproducible and explainable (SIG-IDENT-021, SIG-IDENT-025).
- Tiers 4 (probabilistic) and 5 (weak-signal) create PROPOSED proposals routed to
  review and never auto-write; tier 6 persists no per-pair record (SIG-IDENT-020).
- Sized blocking rejected above a documented ceiling; suffix-alone/state-alone
  prohibited; trigram powers candidate search only, never a decision score
  (SIG-IDENT-023, SIG-IDENT-024).
- Gold set: stratified blocked-pair sampling across weight bands, double adjudication
  with Cohen's kappa, a three-value label vocabulary, written rules, per-label
  provenance, and a frozen, immutable holdout (SIG-IDENT-027).
- Quality gates: pairwise P/R/F1 at each tier boundary + B-cubed cluster P/R on the
  holdout; auto-write tiers demoted to review on a holdout-precision breach; cluster-
  shape alerts for the bad-merge signatures (SIG-IDENT-028, SIG-IDENT-029).
- ER as a distinct, re-runnable pipeline stage between normalize() and load() with its
  own run record, quality report, and rollback; a re-cluster emits new same_as under a
  new ruleset version without destroying the prior clustering; cluster-shape changes
  routed through the public-id stability contract (SIG-RECON-001, SIG-RECON-002,
  SIG-IDENT-032).

ADR-029 records the Splink decision; traceability matrix and risk register updated.

Requirement ids: SIG-IDENT-020, SIG-IDENT-021, SIG-IDENT-023, SIG-IDENT-024,
SIG-IDENT-025, SIG-IDENT-027, SIG-IDENT-028, SIG-IDENT-029, SIG-IDENT-032,
SIG-RECON-001, SIG-RECON-002; touches SIG-IDENT-031 (public-id minting reused).
